sourceContext: Current published St. Thomas Taxi Association web rate table used to transcribe the official taxi schedule effective October 24, 2022. The web retrieval/review date is not a new tariff effective date.
scope: Only the two STT airport release-gate rules already present in the reviewed repository source. This manifest does not approve the rest of the draft tariff. Generic Havensight is intentionally excluded because it is ambiguous between Havensight (Crossroad) and Havensight (WICO).

rules.notes: Official taxi schedule effective 2022-10-24: Airport Terminal to Town. Two or More is modeled as the published per-person fare.

Official taxi schedule effective 2022-10-24: Havensight (Crossroad) to Airport. Two or More is modeled as the published per-person fare. Generic Havensight remains excluded because it is ambiguous with Havensight (WICO).
